shell.title: Your words stay yours.
shell.description: Blind Journal is a zero-knowledge journal designed so only you can unlock and read what you write.
shell.privacyDescription: Your passphrase and encryption keys stay with you. The server authenticates your account and stores encrypted journal data without access to its contents.

usernameRequirements: Use {maxLength, number} characters or fewer: letters A–Z, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens.
passwordRequirements: Use between {minLength, number} and {maxLength, number} characters. A longer passphrase with spaces is easier to remember and harder to guess.

signIn.title: Sign in to your journal
signIn.description: Enter your credentials to continue to your private writing space.

unlock.title: Unlock Blind Journal
unlock.description: Signed in as {username}. Enter your passphrase to restore access to your journal on this device.

createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.description: Choose the credentials you will use to unlock your private journal.

success.signedIn: Welcome back. Your journal is ready.
success.accountCreated: Your account is ready. Welcome to Blind Journal.

errors.invalidCredentials: The username or passphrase is incorrect.
errors.unlockFailed: We could not unlock your encryption keys. Try again.
errors.unauthorized: Sign in to access your journal.
